ns2:course.label: Elec & Electronic Circuits
ns2:course.description: Basic principles of circuit analysis; transient analysis; AC steady-state analysis; introduction to semiconductor devices and fabrication; digital logic circuits; op-amps; A/D and D/A conversion. Credit is not given to Computer or Electrical Engineering majors. Prerequisite: PHYS 212.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given to Computer or Electrical Engineering majors. Prerequisite: PHYS 212.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one lecture and one lab.
